sources.fullCitation: “Heut kommt’s drauf an!” Sheet-music cover for the 1933 film starring Hans Albers, described on the cover as “Ein Boston-Film im Verleih der Siegel-Monopol-Film / Vertrieb Cinema”. Wiener Bohème Verlag, Berlin–Vienna; cover design signed “Herzig”. Digital reproduction: Verein der Freunde und Förderer des Werks von Walter Jurmann, official cover gallery.

media.title: Heut’ kommt’s drauf an (1933) — promotional sheet-music cover
media.description: Cover of the Wiener Bohème Verlag song edition for Heut kommt’s drauf an! (1933), with Hans Albers: “Ein Boston-Film im Verleih der Siegel-Monopol-Film / Vertrieb Cinema.” The cover does not name the composers; design signed Herzig.
media.altText: Vintage promotional cover for “Heut’ kommt’s drauf an,” featuring Hans Albers.
media.rightsNote: The Walter Jurmann cover gallery documents this German promotional cover but supplies no open reuse licence. A graphic work published in Germany in 1933 remained protected on 1 January 1996, so United States copyright was restored under the URAA. The local image is classified as restricted.
